race.comment: BOLD SECRET (4) blew them away here last time with an arrogant win. Concedes some weight to a couple of these but is at his absolute top now and draws the A1 for Callow. Can make it two on the trot. MELLIFLUENT (10) battled away soundly into a midfield finish behind BOLD SECRET last time but was better on a heavy deck here the start prior. Should get the right conditions and is more of a threat this time. CIELAO (7) has been well below her best in her two runs back but is worth more chance third-up. Suspect they push the button and lead on her today. Will steal it if left alone. BIG SUE (3) is knocking on the door and should be hitting his straps fourth-up. Formlines are there but he will need a touch of luck from the draw. HOT STRUT (9) pushed forward and proved too tough for them when challenged here last start. Gets in light with the claimer again and deserves more respect this time.
